minor.issue: Uses datetime.fromisoformat which only accepts full ISO. '2020-01-01' (date-only) parses fine, but any malformed expiry string silently falls through the try/except and lets the code redeem — acceptable since admin controls the value; noting for future validation of the expiry input format on POST/PUT /admin/codes.

ui_bugs.issue: Admin fetches GET /api/apps (public) which excludes hidden apps (hidden=true). Consequence: once an admin marks an app hidden via form-hidden toggle + Save, that app disappears from the admin dashboard's Apps list — no way to edit, unhide, or delete it through the UI. Reproduced during testing: hid TEST_UI_BadgeApp then edit-app-{id}/delete-app-{id} selectors were gone; had to clean up via direct API. Backend already supports ?include_hidden=true — the admin list call just needs to pass that flag.

action_items: HIGH: AdminDashboard.jsx should call api.get('/apps?include_hidden=true') (or a dedicated admin endpoint) so admins can still see, edit, and unhide/delete apps that they've marked hidden. Recommended: change line 107 to `api.get('/apps', { params: { include_hidden: true } })`.
LOW: Add expiry-string format validation on POST/PUT /admin/codes so invalid expiry strings can't slip through silently.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:243 list_apps applies hidden filter to the SAME public route used by AdminDashboard — causes the HIGH bug above. Either (a) require include_hidden=True from admin, or (b) add /api/admin/apps GET for admin listing with hidden apps.

server.py:604 redeem_code catches ValueError from datetime.fromisoformat and silently redeems — an admin typo in expiry field means the expiry check is skipped. Consider rejecting the code (or the admin write) instead.

server.py update_settings uses $set with top-level payload keys — this REPLACES entire nested objects (e.g. sending only {'hero': {...}} replaces the whole hero doc). Frontend AdminSettings.jsx sends the full settings state so it works today; document this behavior or use $set with dotted paths for safer partial updates.

server.py:471 create_review defaults approved=True but the review dialog in AdminReviews.jsx also has an 'Approved' switch defaulting to true — inconsistent with the review-lifecycle intent of moderation. Consider defaulting approved=False so new admin-created content is explicit.
AdminSettings.jsx save() replaces the entire settings doc via PUT — good idempotence but expensive on large payloads; fine for now.

server.py is now ~870 lines. It exceeds the 700-line guideline. Recommend splitting into modules: routers/apps.py, routers/settings.py, routers/reviews.py, routers/winners.py, routers/codes.py, routers/analytics.py, routers/faqs.py, routers/auth.py, and a services/db.py.
No _id leakage confirmed: serialize_doc/serialize_app/serialize_faq all strip _id. Verified in tests for reviews/winners/codes/settings.
AdminAnalytics fetches /admin/analytics on each mount — fine but consider caching; no functional issue.
Redeem endpoint accepts arbitrary dict (payload: dict) — should use a Pydantic model for validation consistency.

rca_of_the_issue: HIGH bug RCA: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.jsx line 107 calls `api.get('/apps')`. Backend /api/apps (server.py list_apps) hard-filters {'hidden': {'$ne': True}} unless include_hidden=true query param is provided. Since the frontend does not pass include_hidden, any app the admin marks as hidden vanishes from the admin's own list, making edit/unhide/delete unreachable through the UI. Reproduced: created TEST_UI_BadgeApp → toggled form-hidden ON → Save → returned to Apps tab → app row no longer present → delete-app-{id} selector timeout. Mitigation: change AdminDashboard.jsx line 107 to `api.get('/apps', { params: { include_hidden: true } })`. Zero backend changes required — the include_hidden param is already supported (verified by test_hidden_app_excluded_from_public_list_and_trending_array).
